XXV, 30</cite>; a. v. fr.—Part. <cite ref="S00009"><he>קָאֵים</he></cite>, apocop. <cite ref="S00007"><he>קָאֵי</he></cite> (q. v.); <he>קָיֵם</he>, <cite ref="S00932"><he>קָיֵים</he></cite>; f. <he>קָיְימָא</he>; pl. <he>קָיְימִין</he>; <he>קָיְימָן</he>, <he>קָיְמ׳</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Joshua 4:10">Targ. Josh. IV, 10</cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 26:15">Targ. O. Ex. XXVI, 15</cite> (Y. <he>קַיָּמִין</he>); a. v. fr.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 19a:14">B. Mets. 19ᵃ</cite> (expl. <he>דייתיקי</he>) <he>דא תהי למֵיקַם וכ׳</he> this is to stand and be, that when I die &c.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 43b:6">B. Bath. 43ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>ארעא היכא דקָיְימָא תֵיקוּם</he> let the land remain where it is (in the possession of the present incumbent).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 65:22">Gen. R. s. 65</cite> <he>ברייך יְקוּם לך</he> may thy Creator stand by thee.

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 11:1:1">Koh. R. to XI, 1</cite> <he>היידי הוא גברא דקָם ליה עיגוליה</he> here is (I am) the man whom his loaf of bread assisted (who was rewarded for throwing his bread into the sea).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 2:1:10">Y. Ab. Zar. II, 40ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>וקָמוּן</he> and they remained (in the trade), v. <cite ref="P01214"><he>עֲקַר</he> I</cite>.
<cite ref="Makkot 22b:2">Macc. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>דקָיְימֵי מקמי וכ׳</he> who stand up before a scroll of the Law and do not stand up before a great man.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 33b:5">Kidd. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>קום מקמיה אביך</he> stand up before thy father.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 33b:8">Ib.</cite> <he>קָאִימְנָא מקמיה</he> I should stand up before him.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 33a:17">Ib.ᵃ</cite> <he>מֵיקַם לא קָאֵי הידור וכ׳</he> he stood not up before them (gentile old men), but he showed them honor.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 7a:6">B. Mets. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>ברשותיה קָיְימָא</he> it is in his possession.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 16">Lev. R. s. 16</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 5:19">Is. V, 19</cite>) <he>נדע דמן הוא דקיימא וכ׳</he> that we know whose counsel will stand (prevail), ours or his; <cite ref="Isaiah 5:19">ib.</cite> <he>לא ק׳ דידי וק׳ דלהון</he> my counsel does not stand, shall theirs stand?; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 266">Yalk. Is. 266</cite> <he>הא קָמַת דידהון דידי לא</he> now, theirs is carried out, and mine should not be?; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 1033">Yalk. Lam. 1033</cite>, sq. (read <he>עצא</he> for <he>על</he>); Pesik. Vattom., p. 133ᵃ (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 1:1:9">Y. Ter. I, 40ᵇ</cite> top <he>בחרש אנן קָיְימִין</he> we are standing at (are treating of) the case of a deaf mute. Y. Maasr. I, 51ᵇ, a. fr. (<cite ref="B00000"><he>ב</he></cite>)<he>מה</he> (<cite ref="A00000"><he>א</he></cite>)<he>נן קיימין</he> what are we treating of?; a. v. fr.—

Yeb. 32ᵃ וקם ליה באשר לא יבנה וכ׳ (by giving ḥălitsah to one of his brother’s widows) he has been declared one ‘who does not build up his brother’s house’ (Deut. XXV, 9), and the Law says, when one has once refused ‘to build’, one must not ‘build’ again (marry another of his brother’s widows); ib. 44ᵃ.—

<cite ref="Shevuot 26a:17">Shebu. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>כי הוו קיימי מקמיה דרב</he> (Ms. F. <he>מפטרי</he>) when they were out of Rab’s sight, opp. <he>כי אתו לקמיה</he>.—<he>ק׳ על</he>, also <he>ק׳ ב־</he> (cmp. <cite ref="P00859"><he>עמד</he></cite>)
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 35b:13">Ab. Zar. 35ᵇ</cite> <he>ליכא למֵיקַם עלה דמילתא</he> it cannot be ascertained; a. e.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 19a:9">B. Mets. 19ᵃ</cite> <he>קָמוּ … במילתא</he> the Rabbis ascertained the case, v. <cite ref="S00999"><he>קִים</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Yevamot 31a">Yeb. 31ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.—
senses.label: a

units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 11:4">Gen. R. s. 11</cite> <he>אנא … קיימין עילויה</he> myself and a certain Jew were bargaining for it (the fish); a. e.—<he>קם ליה בדרבה מיניה</he>, v. <cite ref="S00999"><he>קִים</he></cite>.—<cite ref="V00484"><he>תֵּיקוּ</he></cite>, <he>נֵיקוּ</he> = <cite ref="V00484"><he>תֵּיקוּם</he></cite>, <he>נֵיקוּם</he>.

B. Kam. 96ᵃ תקנתא לעכ״ום נ׳ ונעביד shall we get up and make rules for the benefit of gentile (robbers)? Zeb. 17ᵃ כל חדא וחדא ת׳ בדוכתה (not בדוכתיה; Ms. M. תיקום) let each verse stand in its own place, i.e. you can draw no analogies between them.—Esp. תיקו let it stand, i.e. the question remains undecided. B. Kam. l. c.
<cite ref="Chullin 46a">Ḥull. 46ᵃ</cite>; a. fr.
senses.label: b

units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 35b:13">Ab. Zar. 35ᵇ</cite> <he>נישקול מיניה קלי ונֵיקוּם</he> (prob. to be read <he>ונוֹקִים</he>) let one take a little of it and curdle it.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 35b:13">Ib.</cite> <he>קיימי</he>, v. <cite ref="N00932"><he>נַסְיוּבֵי</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to put up, erect; to appoint, place; to maintain.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 40:2">Targ. O. Ex. XL, 2</cite> <he>תָּקִים</he> (ed. Berl. a. Y. <he>תְּקִים</he>). Ib. 18 <he>ואָקֵים</he> (ed. Berl. <he>ואָקֵים</he> a. <he>ואֵקִים</he>).
<cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 25:7">Targ. O. Deut. XXV, 7</cite> <he>לאָקָמָא</he> ed. Berl. (oth. ed. <he>לַאֲקָ׳</he>; Y. <he>למִיקְמָא</he>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 78:13">Targ. Ps. LXXVIII, 13</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 29:4">Targ. Prov. XXIX, 4</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 39b:5">B. Mets. 39ᵇ</cite> <he>מוֹקְמִינָן … לינוקא</he> we (the court) appoint a guardian over it in behalf of the minor.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 39b:6">Ib.</cite> <he>מיגו דמוֹקִים … מוקמינן וכ׳</he> since one appoints a guardian for the one-sixth portion, we may just as well appoint one for the other sixth.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 33a:4">B. Bath. 33ᵃ</cite> <he>אוֹקְמָהּ</he> … <he>בידיה</he> R. Ḥ. placed it in his possession, i.e. decided that it belonged to him.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 34a:3">Ib. 34ᵃ</cite> <he>מוֹקְמִינָן לה בידיה</he> we would place (or leave) it in his possession; a. v. fr.—
<cite ref="Taanit 8a">Taan. 8ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>אוקים … אמורא</he>, v. <cite ref="A02003"><he>אֲמוֹרָא</he></cite>.—Esp.

senses.gloss: to put a case, to treat with reference to.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 44a:1">B. Bath. 44ᵃ</cite> <he>ולוֹקְמָהּ בגזלן</he> why does he not put the case as treating of a robber?; <he>ולוקמה ביורש</he> let him say, it refers to the case of an heir!; a. fr.—
senses.label: a

senses.gloss: to let stand, place, leave (under the presumption).
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 12b">Keth. 12ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>אוקי ממונא בחזקת מריה</he> leave the money where it is, on the presumption that it belongs to its present owner, i.e. possession has the benefit of the doubt.

<cite ref="Ketubot 12b:11">Ib.</cite> <he>אוֹקְמָהּ אחזקה</he> leave the woman in her ascertained condition (v. <cite ref="H00556"><he>חֲזָקָה</he></cite>), i.e. consider her as having married as a virgin.

<cite ref="Yevamot 31a:11">Yeb. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>אוקי תרי להדי תרי ואשה אוקמה אחזקה</he> leave the two witnesses (on the one side) against the two witnesses (on the other side), and leave the woman &c.; a. fr.—
senses.label: b

units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 6">Num. R. s. 6</cite>, end <he>ורבנן מוֹקְמִין מהאי קרא וכ׳</he> and the Rabbis prove from this verse, that as atonement takes place in day-time, so &c.; a. e.—
senses.label: c

senses.gloss: א׳ טבאות [to place right] to guarantee, secure. Y. Gitt. I, end, 43ᵈ אנן בעי תְּקִימִינָן ט׳ (not טבאת) we want thee to secure us (against an eventual loss of the money which thou art collecting from us for our creditors); בההוא דלא יכיל למִיקְמָה גרמיה ט׳ in the case of one who has no opportunity to secure himself (who cannot get a collector to take the risk), ברם ההוא דיכיל למיקמה וכ׳ but if he finds a collector to take the risk, he may take it away from the one and give it to the other; Y. Kidd. III, 64ᵃ.—
senses.label: d

units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 35a">Ab. Zar. 35ᵃ</cite> [read:] <he>כיון דאוֹקְמֵיה איסורא הוא דקא מוֹקִים ליה וכ׳</he> (v. Ms. M. in Rabb. D. S. a. l., a. note) since it had the effect of curdling the milk, it is the forbidden matter that gave it substance, and therefore it (that forbidden substance) is to be considered as if it were there in its natural state.

<cite ref="Onkelos Numbers 30:14">Targ. Num. XXX, 14</cite>. Targ. Is. l. c.

<cite ref="Nedarim 70a:1">Ned. 70ᵃ</cite> <he>דהא קַיְּימֵיה לנדריה היום</he> (not <he>קיימי</he>, v. Rashi) for he has confirmed the vow to-day.
<cite ref="Nedarim 70a:3">Ib.</cite> (h. form) <he>כיון דקִיְּימוֹ קִיְּימוֹ</he> since he once confirmed it, it remains confirmed.

<cite ref="Ketubot 19a:6">Keth. 19ᵃ</cite> <he>זילו קַיְּימוּ שטרייכו</he> go and get evidence for the identification of your documents, and then come to court. Y. Gitt. I, end, 43ᵈ <he>קיַּימְתֵּיה מדאמר וכ׳</he> thou canst substantiate thy opinion by referring to what R. … said. Pesik. Haʿomer, p. 72ᵇ <he>למְקַיְּימָא לכון וכ׳</he> in order to fulfill on you the prophecy (<cite ref="Deuteronomy 33:29">Deut. XXXIII, 29</cite>) &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 643:10">Yalk. V, 44ᵈ <he>ואנא יכיל קַיֵּים</he> and I can ascertain it (by experiment); a. v. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מְקַיַּים</he>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 55a:15">Ber. 55ᵃ</cite> <he>לא חלמא טבא מק׳ וכ׳</he> (Ms. F. <he>מתקיים</he>) neither a good dream comes true entirely, nor a bad dream &c.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 33:12">Targ. Ez. XXXIII, 12</cite>; a. fr.—Y. Sabb. VI, end, 8ᵈ [read:] <he>תִּתְקַיֵּים לכון נפשיכין בהדין יומכון היך דקַיַּימְתּוּן וכ׳</he> may your life be restored on that day of yours (when your time comes), as you have restored my life on this day.

<cite ref="Eruvin 54a:3">Erub. 54ᵃ</cite> <he>כי היכי דתתקיים בידך ותוריך חיי</he> (not <he>ביך</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) in order that it (thy learning) may be preserved in thy possession, and thou mayest live long; a. e.
